title: The kernel of the completion modulo a power of the ideal
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq A$ a finitely generated ideal, $A^\wedge=\varprojlim_nA/I^n$ the $I$-adic completion of $A$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] with $\iota:A\to A^\wedge$, and for $N\ge1$ let $\pi^\wedge_N:A^\wedge\to A/I^N$, $(x_n)_n\mapsto x_N$. Then $\pi^\wedge_N$ is a surjective homomorphism of $A$-algebras with $\pi^\wedge_N\circ\iota$ the quotient map $A\to A/I^N$, and its kernel is $I^NA^\wedge$ (the ideal of $A^\wedge$ generated by $\iota(I^N)$).
